name: YOUTUBE_API_KEY
unlocks: Keyword search for Shorts (per language), age-matched baselines.
get: Google Cloud console → APIs & Services → enable YouTube Data API v3 → Credentials → API key.

name: IG_GRAPH_TOKEN
unlocks: Instagram watch list (Business Discovery), hashtag top posts (30 hashtags / 7 days), and your own reels' insights for Your performance (needs instagram_manage_insights).
get: Meta for Developers → app with instagram_basic + pages_read_engagement (+ instagram_manage_insights, instagram_manage_comments for own performance) → long-lived token.

name: IG_GRAPH_USER_ID
unlocks: Your Instagram business account id (pairs with IG_GRAPH_TOKEN).
get: Graph API Explorer: me/accounts → instagram_business_account.id.

name: APIFY_TOKEN
unlocks: TikTok discovery, TikTok watch list, trending hashtags.
get: apify.com → Settings → Integrations → Personal API token.

name: APIFY_TRENDS_ACTOR
unlocks: Actor id for trending hashtags (e.g. a TikTok Creative Center trends actor from the Apify store).
get: Pick an actor in the Apify store; copy its id (user~actor).

name: META_AD_LIBRARY_TOKEN
unlocks: Ads scout: ads delivered in the EU (copy, start/stop dates, platforms, EU reach) plus political/issue ads anywhere. US commercial ads are NOT in the API; use APIFY_ADS_ACTOR for those.
get: Confirm your identity and location at facebook.com/ID → Meta for Developers app → Graph API Explorer → user access token (exchange it for a long-lived one).

name: TIKTOK_RESEARCH_CLIENT_KEY
cost: free, once TikTok approves your application
unlocks: Ads scout: TikTok ads shown in the EEA (first/last shown, reach, video/images; no ad copy).
get: TikTok for Developers → apply for the Commercial Content API → after approval, copy the research client key from the portal's research section.

name: TIKTOK_RESEARCH_CLIENT_SECRET
unlocks: Pairs with TIKTOK_RESEARCH_CLIENT_KEY (client-credentials token, valid 2 hours).
get: Same place as the client key.

name: APIFY_ADS_ACTOR
unlocks: Ads scout: the Meta Ad Library for any country, including the US (e.g. apify~facebook-ads-scraper).
get: Pick a Meta Ad Library actor in the Apify store; copy its id (user~actor). Check its price per result.

name: APIFY_TIKTOK_ADS_ACTOR
unlocks: Ads scout: TikTok Creative Center Top Ads for an industry (no keyword search, no start dates). Set ads.tiktok_top_input.industries in the profile, e.g. [Home Improvement].
get: Use pulsedata~tiktok-creative-center-top-ads-scraper (the mapping is written and tested for it).

name: APIFY_GOOGLE_ADS_ACTOR
unlocks: Ads scout: Google Ads Transparency Center (Search, YouTube, Display) by competitor domain and name, with first/last shown dates. Runs in batches of 6 competitors.
get: Use automation-lab~google-ads-scraper (the mapping is written and tested for it).

name: APIFY_GOOGLE_TRENDS_ACTOR
unlocks: Seasonality, rising searches and wording per business (profile demand: block). Default apify~google-trends-scraper when empty. Uses APIFY_TOKEN.
get: Leave empty for Apify's own actor, or paste another Google Trends actor id.

name: APIFY_MAX_USD_PER_RUN
unlocks: Spend cap for each Apify actor run (Apify maxTotalChargeUsd): a run stops at it instead of using up the month. 0 = no cap. It caps one run, not the total: each advertiser and keyword is its own run.
get: A number in USD, e.g. 0.5.

name: VIRAL_SCOUT_MCP_PAID
unlocks: 1 lets MCP clients (any Claude session, any repo) start paid runs: start_run, ads_run, local_competitors. Off: they get the latest results and the CLI command instead. Restart the MCP server after changing it.
get: 1 to allow, empty or 0 to block.

name: GOOGLE_PLACES_API_KEY
cost: free: a monthly allowance per API, billed above it
unlocks: Local competitors: nearby businesses in your niche and their public social channels.
get: Google Cloud console → enable Places API (New) → Credentials → API key (restrict it).

name: TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN
unlocks: Push alerts for new outliers (or point a profile's alerts.env_file at another app's bot).
get: Telegram → @BotFather → /newbot.

name: TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID
unlocks: Where alerts go.
get: Message your bot, open https://api.telegram.org/bot<token>/getUpdates, copy message.chat.id.

name: YT_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID
unlocks: Your performance: your own channel's views, watch time, avg % viewed, retention curves, shares, subscribers gained (OAuth client, pairs with the secret and refresh token).
get: Google Cloud console → enable YouTube Analytics API + YouTube Data API v3 → OAuth consent screen → Credentials → OAuth client ID → Desktop app.

name: YT_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET
unlocks: The Desktop OAuth client's secret.
get: Same OAuth client → Client secret.

name: YT_OAUTH_REFRESH_TOKEN
unlocks: Read-only access to your channel's analytics without logging in each time.
get: Run: python -m viral_scout perf auth youtube (opens Google's consent page, saves the token here).

name: META_ADS_TOKEN
unlocks: Your performance: your Meta ads' impressions, hook rate (3-s plays), ThruPlays, quartiles, CTR, CPC, CPM, leads, purchases, ROAS, daily frequency for fatigue.
get: Meta for Developers → app with Marketing API → Business Settings → System user with ads_read on the ad account → generate token.

name: META_AD_ACCOUNT_ID
unlocks: Which ad account to read (act_123… or the number).
get: Ads Manager → account dropdown, or Business Settings → Ad accounts.

name: TIKTOK_ADS_TOKEN
unlocks: Your performance: your TikTok ads' 2-s/6-s views, 25–100% views, avg play time, CTR, CPC, CPM, conversions, CPA, ROAS, daily frequency.
get: TikTok for Business developers → create an app with Reporting permission → authorize your advertiser account → long-term access token.

name: TIKTOK_ADVERTISER_ID
unlocks: Which advertiser account to read.
get: TikTok Ads Manager → account info (Advertiser ID).

name: VIRAL_SCOUT_YTDLP
unlocks: Path to a yt-dlp clone with newer extractors than the pip package.
get: git clone https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp

name: OBSIDIAN_VAULT
unlocks: Your Obsidian vault folder. Profiles write reports, ideas notes and the swipe file to ${OBSIDIAN_VAULT}/projects/<project>/…; New business lists the vault's projects. Unset, they go to reports/<profile>/ in the repo.
get: The folder that holds your vault's .obsidian folder. Best as a user environment variable (PowerShell: [Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable('OBSIDIAN_VAULT','D:\Obsidian\vault','User')), then restart the terminal and the dashboard. Saved here it goes into .env, which only the Python CLI reads.
